ConsentConfig.title:
=============================================================================
 CONSENT MANAGEMENT CONFIGURATION PROTO
 =============================================================================
 Defines comprehensive consent management for GDPR, CCPA, and Google Consent
 Mode v2 compliance across the ecosystem.

 This schema enables:
 - Multi-jurisdiction consent management (EU, US, India)
 - Google Consent Mode v2 with regional defaults
 - Cross-domain consent synchronization
 - Entity-specific privacy policies
 - Granular consent categories
 - Consent versioning and audit trails

 Related Documentation:
 - Implementation Guide: ../CONSENT-EXAMPLES.md
 - Mappings: consent-mappings.yml
 - Parent Schema: ecosystem.proto
 =============================================================================
